technical_analysis: ## Schema: offers_in_schema 1. **Why it matters for AI/LLMs:** Including offers in schema markup helps search engines understand pricing and availability, enhancing visibility in search results. 2. **Current state:** The current page does not include any offer details in the schema markup. 3. **Exact fix:** ```json { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Product", "name": "boAt Airdopes Supreme | Wireless Earbuds with 50 Hours Playback, AI ENx™ with Wind Noise Reduction, Cinematic Spatial Audio", "brand": { "@type": "Brand", "name": "boAtlifestylein" }, "offers": { "@type": "Offer", "price": "1299.0", "priceCurrency": "INR", "availability": "https://schema.org/InStock" } } ``` 4. **Score impact:** +2 points in schema ## Entity: product_group 1. **Why it matters for AI/LLMs:** Defining a product group helps categorize the product, improving its discoverability and relevance in search results. 2. **Current state:** The current page does not specify a product group. 3. **Exact fix:** ```json { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "Product", "name": "boAt Airdopes Supreme | Wireless Earbuds with 50 Hours Playback, AI ENx™ with Wind Noise Reduction, Cinematic Spatial Audio", "category": "Wireless Earbuds" } ``` 4. **Score impact:** +1 point in entity ## Trust: has_contact_page 1. **Why it matters for AI/LLMs:** A contact page enhances trustworthiness and provides customers with a way to reach out for support or inquiries. 2. **Current state:** The site does not have a contact page linked from the navigation or footer. 3. **Exact fix:** ```html Contact Us ``` 4. **Score impact:** +1 point in trust signals ##
